#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace std;

int countLetters(int a, int b, int l, int r) {
    string sb;
    for (int i = 0; i < a; ++i) {
        sb.push_back('a' + i);
    }
    char ch = l < a ? sb[a - 1] : sb[b < a ? b : a - 1];
    for (int i = 0; i < b; ++i) {
        sb.push_back(ch);
    }

    bool used[30] = {false};
    for (int i = 0; i < a; ++i) {
        used[sb[sb.size() - i - 1] - 'a'] = true;
    }

    int ptr = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < a; ++i) {
        while (used[ptr]) {
            ++ptr;
        }
        sb.push_back('a' + ptr);
        used[ptr] = true;
    }

    ch = sb[min(b, a - 1) + a + b];
    for (int i = 0; i < b; ++i) {
        sb.push_back(ch);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < a + b; ++i) {
        sb.push_back(sb[i]);
    }

    uint64_t mask = 0ULL;
    for (int i = l; i <= r; ++i) {
        mask |= 1ULL << (sb[i] - 'a');
    }
    return __builtin_popcountll(mask);
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int a, b, l, r;
    cin >> a >> b >> l >> r;
    l--; r--;

    int len = a + b;
    int dif = r - l;
    int ans;
    if (dif >= 2 * len) {
        ans = max(a + 1, 2 * a - b);
    } else {
        r -= len * (l / len);
        l %= len;
        ans = countLetters(a, b, l, r);
    }
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
